purpose: Provenance ledger for externally testable claims in the concrete Culture field atlas.

sources.title: Rocker- og bandesituationen i Danmark 2025
sources.publisher: National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet / Danish Police
sources.claim_scope: Named rocker/gang conflict pairs and Danish police aggregate 2025 environment statistics.
sources.limitations: Police describes figures as dynamic snapshots; conflict and environment-level statistics do not assign criminal conduct to every person associated with a named formation.

sources.title: Højesteret - sag 123/2020, opløsning af Loyal to Familia
sources.claim_scope: Supreme Court treatment of Loyal to Familia as an association and the legal basis for dissolution.
sources.limitations: The judgment concerns the organization and legal dissolution; it is not a finding that every person ever associated with LTF committed the same conduct.

sources.title: From instigator to perpetrator: how violence-as-a-service operates
sources.claim_scope: Four-stage VaaS model: instigator, recruiter, enabler and perpetrator; recruitment through encrypted messaging or gaming/chat platforms.
sources.limitations: Europol presents a typical operational model, not a claim that every violent offence follows the same chain.

sources.title: Operational Taskforce GRIMM
sources.claim_scope: Operational definition of violence-as-a-service, taskforce partners and youth recruitment mechanisms.
sources.limitations: Operational/law-enforcement framing; individual investigations retain separate evidentiary and legal statuses.

sources.title: Teenagers recruited as hitmen: Denmark and Sweden strike back at violence-as-a-service
sources.claim_scope: Cross-border investigations into suspected recruitment of young people for targeted killings in Denmark and Sweden, including use of encrypted/social platforms.
sources.limitations: The article reports arrests and suspicions in ongoing investigations; suspicion is not conviction. Minors are not named in this atlas.

sources.title: NXIVM Leader Keith Raniere Sentenced to 120 Years in Prison for Racketeering and Sex Trafficking Offenses
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice, Eastern District of New York
sources.claim_scope: Raniere's 2019 federal convictions, 2020 sentence, the racketeering enterprise, DOS recruitment and collateral mechanisms proved at trial.
sources.limitations: DOJ prosecution/sentencing summary; claims about other participants must follow their own dispositions rather than being inferred from association.

sources.title: Blocking Kiwifarms
sources.claim_scope: Cloudflare's decision to block Kiwi Farms from its services and Cloudflare's stated emergency rationale.
sources.limitations: First-party account by an infrastructure provider explaining its own decision; it does not independently establish every factual claim made about forum users or targets.

sources.title: The governance of snarking: Anti-fandom as tiny publics
sources.claim_scope: Digital ethnography of two celebrity snark spaces, including emergent rules, sanctions, vernacular, knowledge hierarchies and collective identity.
sources.limitations: Study of two spaces; findings illuminate mechanisms but should not be generalized to every anti-fandom community.

sources.title: Star Wars Kid: The Rise of the Digital Shadows
sources.claim_scope: Ghyslain Raza's public participation in a documentary about the 2003 viral video, involuntary publication and later reflection on digital memory.
sources.limitations: Documentary framing and participant recollection; the atlas uses it for the public trajectory and reclamation story rather than as a complete biography.

sources.title: Mini-Lesson for Star Wars Kid: The Rise of Digital Shadows
sources.claim_scope: Educational framing emphasizing the human behind a viral caricature and the effects of platform-mediated sharing.
sources.limitations: Educational interpretation rather than a court or empirical causal finding.

sources.title: Smithsonian Anthology of Hip-Hop and Rap
sources.publisher: Smithsonian National Museum of African American History and Culture
sources.claim_scope: Institutional preservation of hip-hop's genesis, rise, evolution and cultural impact.
sources.limitations: Museum/canonical framing; the broad history of hip-hop contains many local scenes and contested origin narratives beyond a single institutional summary.

sources.title: National Museum of African American History and Culture and Smithsonian Folkways Announce Aug. 20 Release of the Smithsonian Anthology of Hip-Hop and Rap
sources.publisher: Smithsonian National Museum of African American History and Culture
sources.claim_scope: Hip-hop's growth from parks of the Bronx to broad American and worldwide influence and Smithsonian preservation.
sources.limitations: Institutional overview; does not imply a single linear or centralized pathway for the entire culture.

sources.title: 2025 in figures
sources.claim_scope: Audited combined 2025 international figures: revenue above EUR 2.6 billion, 98% operating income from private sources and more than 7.5 million private donors/foundations.
sources.limitations: Combined international reporting; amounts are rounded and do not identify every individual donor-to-programme path.

sources.title: ICRC Annual Report 2025
sources.publisher: International Committee of the Red Cross
sources.claim_scope: 2025 donor contributions of around CHF 1.76 billion and published donor-source mix, including 84% governments and the European Commission.
sources.limitations: Organization's annual reporting; funding proportions describe source mix and do not by themselves establish donor control over specific operational decisions.
